cdc_auto_drop_slot.description: Whether PostHog drops the replication slot automatically when lag is critical. Only applies in 'posthog' management mode.

cdc_lag_critical_threshold_mb.description: Replication lag in MB above which the lag is critical. Must be higher than the warning threshold.

cdc_lag_warning_threshold_mb.description: Replication lag in MB above which a warning shows. Must be lower than the critical threshold.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this external data source.
